_README: Reference copy of the production login roster. This file is NOT read by the
server — it documents what the Railway env vars should contain. Update it
whenever ADMIN_EMAILS / AUTH_USERS change so the roster is reviewable in git.
ADMIN_EMAILS  = comma-separated real Google emails -> role admin, scope all.
Admins keep their own name/email in the audit trail.
AUTH_USERS    = JSON map: real Google email -> internal associate email.
Keys are lowercased by the server, values must match the
Anyone signing in with a Google account absent from BOTH lists is turned
away at /login.html?error=denied and never reaches the dashboard.
